notes: Intro: product team (CTO + Head of Real-time) interested in sub-60ms p95 for live chat and reranking pipeline.
Primary pain: token-level cost spikes during market open hours; current infra runs out of budget when they hit burst traffic.
Quote from CTO on 2026-02-18 call: 'If we can get consistent 40–60ms p95 at predictable cost, we move to reserved capacity.'

Interest areas called out: aggressive batching without breaking 50ms latency SLO, prefix/KV caching for repeated context (pricing snapshot), 4-bit quantization feasibility for their tuned Llama-variant.
They want Redwood Optimize to run candidate configs: batching profiles by seq-length, caching TTLs per-user-session, lower-bit quantization recipes and expected accuracy delta.
Security ask: VPC private control plane + KMS integration; EU data residency enforcement; 12-month audit log retention.
POC constraints: cannot send raw payment identifiers off-network; must be tokenized before leaving infra — will need a redaction layer or on-prem connector.
Procurement notes: preferred contract term 12 months, but legal requests SOC2/ISO27001 evidence before commit.
They requested a perf benchmark that mirrors their production distribution: 60% short chats (~32 tokens), 30% reranking requests (prefix 128 tokens + 16 candidates), 10% embeddings (batch size 64).
Cost target: <$0.50 per 1k effective tokens for average traffic profile; willing to trade small latency increases for 25% cost reduction via quantization and batching.
Technical preference: fallbacks between an FP16 high-quality model and a 4-bit quantized variant for peak-cost mitigation. Automatic routing by cost/latency tiers is a must.
Workshop planned: architecture + perf knobs (batching window, KV cache hit strategy, quantization profile) with Redwood infra team during benchmark week.
Next technical step: provide traffic replay + dataset (anonymized) by 2026-03-03 so Redwood can run side-by-side benchmarks.
Sales note: good champion in Head of Real-time (Eva Novak) — very technical, positive about Redwood's runtime and observability UI demos.
Potential upsell: Dedicated pool + Optimize advisory service; Private (VPC) if SOC2 proof looks good to procurement.

requirements_summary: Latency: target p95 40-60ms for chat + reranking under typical load; p50 < 20ms desired.
Throughput: sustained 3k–5k requests/sec during market hours; burst up to 12k qps for <2 min windows.
Cost sensitivity: prioritize unit cost reduction, willing to accept minor quality regression from 8-bit->4-bit if market impact negligible.
Modeling: tuned Llama-variant + open-source reranker (pairwise scoring); want Redwood to validate quantized accuracy vs baseline.
Operational: need per-route latency+token-cost dashboards, automatic fallback routing between model classes, and A/B rollout capability for quantized models.
